name: Sessions Health AI Assist
description: Sessions Health AI Assist is a HIPAA-compliant AI documentation add-on for the Sessions Health EHR at ~$40/clinician/month. The platform takes an 'ethical AI' approach: PII is masked before processing, data is never used for model training, and all notes are generated as editable drafts. Supports SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and Narrative formats with live telehealth transcription directly within Sessions Health. Key differentiator: AI Treatment Summaries pull client history into structured overviews for case consultations and transfers of care. Base Sessions Health plan starts at $39/month for first practitioner. Realistic total: $79/month (base + AI Assist). Free tier available with client limits.

faqs.q: How much does Sessions Health AI Assist cost in 2026?
faqs.a: AI Assist costs approximately $40/clinician/month as an add-on to Sessions Health. Realistic total: Sessions Health Professional ($39/mo) + AI Assist ($40/mo) = $79/month. Telehealth adds another $10/month. A 30-day free trial is available.

faqs.q: What is Sessions Health's 'ethical AI' approach?
faqs.a: Sessions Health masks PII (personally identifiable information) before processing with AI. The AI never learns from or retains your notes, and data is never used for model training or shared with third parties. All AI-generated notes are drafts requiring clinician review.

faqs.q: Can I use Sessions Health AI Assist without Sessions Health EHR?
faqs.a: No. AI Assist is a native add-on exclusively for Sessions Health users. If you use a different EHR, consider standalone options like Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo).

AI Treatment Summaries pull a client's treatment history into one structured, editable overview. Useful for case consultations, transfers of care, and discharge planning—saves significant time compared to manual chart review.

faqs.q: Sessions Health AI Assist vs Mentalyc: which is better?
faqs.a: If you're already on Sessions Health, AI Assist ($40/mo add-on) provides seamless integration. If you use a different EHR or want modality-aware notes (CBT, DBT), Mentalyc ($20-70/mo standalone) is more flexible. Both prioritize ethical AI and privacy.
